plugin.description: Controls the deck itself: switch pages, switch a button's state, change brightness and put the deck to sleep.

ChangeState.description: Switches an input to another of its states. This is how a button does something different the second time it is pressed - put it on state 0 pointing at state 1, and one on state 1 pointing back at 0.

state.description: The state to switch to, counting from 0.

return_timeout.description: Seconds until it falls back to the previous state on its own. 0 disables it - use it for an arm/confirm button that should not stay armed.

target_input.description: Leave this out to switch this input itself. Set {"input_type": "keys", "json_identifier": "1x0"} to switch a different key instead.

ChangePage.description: Switches the deck to another page.

selected_page.description: Absolute path of the page json file, as listed under the available pages.

return_timeout.description: Seconds until the deck returns to the previous page. 0 disables it.

deck_number.description: Only needed to change the page on a different deck than the one the button is on.

GoToPreviousPage.description: Switches back to the page the deck was on before. Pair it with Change Page to build a menu you can leave again.

ChangeBrightness.description: Sets the deck's screen brightness to a fixed value.

AdjustBrightness.description: Raises or lowers the deck's brightness by a step. Good on a dial, where turning it dims and brightens.

GoToSleep.description: Turns the deck's screens off immediately, as the screensaver would.
